verdict.rationale: The evidence shows TaxJar flagging states where economic nexus thresholds are met and AutoFile handling ongoing returns and remittances. Neither is a remediation path for past-due exposure. Nothing in the pack documents voluntary disclosure agreements or back-filing of prior periods, so nexus detection, forward-looking filing and a historical data archive are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, past-due exposure has a remediation path — voluntary disclosure agreements or back-filing support to clean up jurisdictions where I should have been collecting
